description: This file is a configuration script for Vite, a build tool for frontend projects. It defines the Vite configuration object with plugin setup, environment variable handling, JSX processing options, and server/mode settings for a React-based application.

methods.name: defineConfig
methods.description: Defines the Vite configuration object, accepting a function that takes configuration mode parameters.

methods.name: loadEnv
methods.description: Loads environment variables based on the current mode and working directory, filtering for specific prefixes.
